title: Configuration check reports failure after opening the wrong path
root_cause: The validation script attempts to read config/settings.ini, but the repository contains config/setting.ini. PHP reports the missing file and the later TAP failure follows from that path mismatch.

relevant_evidence.why: The missing-file warning precedes the failing TAP result.
The script reads the plural path and fails when the open fails.
The existing configuration uses a singular file name.
